🚨 Player of the month! 🚨

After a unanimous vote from the coaching committee, Tom Efford has been awarded the August player of the month award. 

Tom has made the step up to first team football this summer and has taken to it instantly, helping the team to 3 clean sheets and picking up 2 player of the match awards in the 7 games he has featured in.

#UpTheTown

⚽️ September Fixtures! ⚽️

After a hectic August, we now go into a more manageable September. 3 home games, starting with Allscott Heath, then a rearranged match vs Alsager Town, before a final league game away to Cheadle Heath Nomads. We end the month with a Macron Cup 1st round match at home to Bilston Town! 

Don’t miss them! 

#UpTheTown

⚽️ Next Up! ⚽️

The Town boys will be looking to bounce back after Saturdays result as we welcome Allscott Heath to Evans Park this Saturday. The visitors have had a tough start to the season but picked up an impressive 7-0 win last week and will be looking to build on that. 

Be there to support the lads.

Don’t miss it! 

#UpTheTown
